not_computable.T06: the registered estimand is the median WITHIN-UNIT lambda effect over (E4-eligible vertex x training seed) pairs, both lambda drawn on the SAME vertex (OCCUPANCY_VERTICES.json, occupancy/vertex_sampler.py). The executed block has arm-level HighOcc and LowOcc runs over the ordinary seed list and no vertex draw, so it contains no within-vertex pair. Gate (c) is therefore not evaluable; the arm-level HighOcc-LowOcc difference is reported below under `descriptive_only` and is NOT T06.

not_computable.T10: the accuracy-mediated decomposition has no executable mediator binding in MATH_SPEC.json; per-language accuracy is emitted below as a descriptive table instead of being aggregated into a test whose form is not registered executably.
not_computable.T11: requires the aggregate HIGH-resource language set. No frozen high/low-resource partition of the 12 endpoint languages exists (refine-logs/LANGUAGE_FREEZE.json is absent) and evaluation labels already exist, so any partition chosen now would be post-hoc. Gate (d) is not evaluable.
not_computable.T12: requires an unseen-entity flag per evaluation item. predictions.jsonl carries id, language, gold/prediction index and confidence only; the endpoint receipt records train_concept_overlap = 0 for the whole set, which is a set-level property and does not induce the per-item seen/unseen split this test reads.
not_computable.T13: requires T = ceil(|L|/4) over the LowRes languages surviving the R19-F1 retention floor, 'computed once and FROZEN in refine-logs/LANGUAGE_FREEZE.json before any evaluation label exists, never recomputed per replicate'. That file does not exist and evaluation labels already exist. Gate (d) is not evaluable.
